title: Book record
description: One catalogued work. Emitted by scripts/adapters/*, one JSON object per line of data/books.ndjson.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped when a required field is added, forcing a full re-ingest.

author.description: Null is legitimate and preferred over a guess; Wikisource has no single author field.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical human-readable page for the work.

downloads.description: Built at ingest time. URLs point at the origin; no binary is stored in this repo.

categories.description: Cleaned taxonomy, derived in Phase 3. Empty until then.

rawCategories.description: Unfiltered upstream categories, retained so the taxonomy can be re-derived offline.

chapters.description: Subpage count; 0 for a single-page work.

quality.description: Wikisource proofread level, routed out of categories.

license.description: Upstream content licence, e.g. 'PD' or 'CC-BY-SA-4.0'. Not relicensed by this repo.

updated.description: ISO date of last successful ingest.

extra.description: Unvalidated source-specific data. Absorbs new fields without a schema bump.

excerpt.description: The work's opening lines, truncated. NOT a summary - no summary source exists for this corpus. Verse line breaks are shown as ' / '.

description.description: Wikidata item description (vi, else en). Present for ~5% of works.

thumbnail.description: Real cover image where one exists (~0.6%). Most works have none; the site generates a typographic cover instead.

year.description: Publication year, parsed from the existing 'Tác phẩm YYYY' category. No API call needed.
